messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2: Observed sustained economy-tier saturation and high 95p latency in ap-southeast-1. Auto-escalating to on-call. Link: https://telemetry.internal/r/3105000000

maria: seeing a big queue growth on economy pools in ap-southeast-1, 95p latency ~1.8s, error rate creeping up 2.3% (vs baseline 0.1%).

jonathan: confirming. Traffic heatmap shows APAC steering policy shifted more weight to economy lane after a slow drain in dedicated pools. Likely cause: reactive autoscaler + recent policy tweak from yesterday.

ashley: tagging @maria @jonathan — can we temporarily reduce economy weight in APAC and add a tenant-level cap? want to avoid wholesale disable if possible. :thinking_face:

maria: I can apply a weighted trim and add soft quota. Applying small change first to avoid thrash.

maria: /policy update --region ap-southeast-1 --policy smart-routing \n  --set "tier_weights.economy=0.4" --set "tier_weights.standard=0.55" --set "fallback=standard"

incident-bot: policy:update accepted (change_id=chg-3105-11). Applying now.

kai: which customers are in the hot path? Need to call the top 5 to warn if we push to standard.

maria: top affected tenants: tenant-42, tenant-omega, tenant-acme-intl, tenant-zen. Notifying customer-success.

jonathan: I'm seeing immediate drop in queue depth, 95p latency down to ~1.1s after the weight change. Error rate trending down. Still watching.

ashley: Recommend a secondary guard: per-tenant rate-limits for economy in APAC to 10r/s for noisy tenants. That prevents noisy tenants from re-saturating economy while we rebalance.

maria: running per-tenant cap now:

```
POST /admin/tenants/tenant-42/rate_limit
{ "region": "ap-southeast-1", "tier": "economy", "rps": 10 }
```

incident-bot: rate_limit:update accepted for tenant-42 (rl-3105-22).

jonathan: good. Also flipping region pin for enterprise customers to prefer eu-west as secondary for reads that are latency-tolerant. config change: prefer_regions = [eu-west, us-west].

ashley: i'm cautious about moving too many to eu-west — cost spike there could create ripple. let's set a cap on eu-west burst capacity and monitor.

sre-liz: please update the incident doc and the runbook step: "adaptive-weight-trim -> per-tenant caps -> monitor 10m". Also add rollback command in doc.

maria: updated doc and added rollback snippet. Current monitoring window 10m. Next check at +5m.

jonathan: metrics look stable now, request latency improving, error rate back to 0.15%. Keeping the trimmed weights for 15m then will gradually ramp if stable.

kai: CS confirmed tenant-omega saw small transient errors but no data loss. They acknowledged mitigation.

incident-bot: Mitigation in place. Will auto-close incident if metrics remain stable for 15m. Remind: followup ticket for policy tuning and autoscaler behavior investigation (TKT-3105). :white_check_mark:"
